cards.ex: Rise and shine, sleepyhead! It's time to start the day.
cards.exUz: Tur va porla, uyquchi! Kunni boshlash vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Ertalab uyg'onish va tetik bo'lish. Ko'pincha hazil yoki o'ynoqi tarzda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: Once I get to work, it's off to the races; I barely have time to breathe.
cards.exUz: Ishga borganimdan so'ng, poyga boshlanadi; deyarli nafas olishga vaqtim yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Jadal va band bo'lgan kunning boshlanishi, tez va qizg'in boshlanish.

cards.ex: My morning ritual includes meditation and a cup of green tea.
cards.exUz: Mening ertalabki odatim meditatsiya va bir chashka ko'k choyni o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Har kuni ertalab takrorlanadigan odatlar yoki harakatlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: I like to get a head start on my work by arriving early.
cards.exUz: Men erta kelib, ishimni erta boshlashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinroq boshlash, ustunlikka erishish uchun erta harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I need my daily dose of caffeine to function properly.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi ishlashim uchun kunlik kofein dozamga muhtojman.
cards.uzDef: Har kuni olinadigan yoki qabul qilinadigan narsa, odatda ma'lum miqdorda.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to make it to the meeting on time.
cards.exUz: Agar yig'ilishga o'z vaqtida yetib borishni istasak, tezroq harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilishni boshlash, shoshilish, vaqtni yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: Traveling is a great way to get a change of pace from my usual routine.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish odatiy tartibimdan o'zgarish qilishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagi tartibdan yoki odatlardan farqli bo'lgan narsa, yangilik.

cards.ex: I always set aside time each day to read a book.
cards.exUz: Men har doim har kuni kitob o'qish uchun vaqt ajrataman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir faoliyat uchun vaqt ajratish, rejalashtirish.

cards.ex: Once I started my new routine, things started to fall into place.
cards.exUz: Yangi tartibni boshlaganimdan so'ng, narsalar o'z joyiga tusha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan asta-sekin o'z-o'zidan to'g'ri bo'lib ketmoq, tartibga kelmoq.

cards.ex: I'm trying to break the cycle of procrastination by setting small goals.
cards.exUz: Men kichik maqsadlar qo'yish orqali kechiktirish aylanasi buzishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi va salbiy odatni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: I make it a point to call my parents every Sunday.
cards.exUz: Men har yakshanba ota-onamga qo'ng'iroq qilishni maqsad qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy qaror qabul qilish, biror narsani doimo bajarishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After a long day, I enjoy my creature comforts like a hot bath and a good book.
cards.exUz: Uzoq kundan so'ng, issiq vanna va yaxshi kitob kabi qulayliklarimdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Odamni qulay va baxtli qiladigan narsalar, sharoitlar.

cards.ex: My plans aren't set in stone yet; I might change them later.
cards.exUz: Mening rejam hali toshga o'yib yozilmagan; keyinroq ularni o'zgartirishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirish mumkin bo'lmagan, qat'iy o'rnatilgan.

cards.ex: It takes a lot of stick-to-itiveness to learn a new language.
cards.exUz: Yangi tilni o'rganish uchun juda ko'p qatiyatlilik talab etiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani oxirigacha qattiq turib qilish qobiliyati, sabr-toqat.

cards.ex: Stress is part and parcel of being a student.
cards.exUz: Stress talaba bo'lishning ajralmas qismi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning muhim va ajralmas qismi.

cards.ex: Our team works like clockwork; we always meet our deadlines.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoamiz soat kabi ishlaydi; biz har doim muddatlarga rioya qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi va samarali ishlash, aniq tartibda ishlash.

cards.ex: Once I get in the groove, I can write for hours without stopping.
cards.exUz: Bir marta ritmga tushsam, soatlab to'xtamasdan yozishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ish yoki faoliyatda muvaffaqiyatli va qulay bo'lish.

cards.ex: I try to break up the monotony of my workday by taking short walks.
cards.exUz: Men qisqa sayrlar qilib, ish kunimning zerikishini yo'qotishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Zerikarli vaziyatni yoki tartibni o'zgartirish, zerikishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: My sleep schedule is completely out of whack since I started working nights.
cards.exUz: Men tunlari ishlay boshlaganimdan beri uyqu jadvalim butunlay buzilgan.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz, buzilgan yoki normal holatdan tashqarida.

cards.ex: The party really got into full swing after dinner.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqatdan so'ng ziyofat chindan ham to'liq kuchga kirdi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq tezlikda va samaradorlikda ishlash, avjiga chiqmoq.

cards.ex: I have to keep on top of my emails to avoid missing important deadlines.
cards.exUz: Muhim muddatlarni o'tkazib yubormaslik uchun elektron pochta xabarlarimni nazorat ostida ushlab turishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yoki ishlarni nazoratda ushlab turish, ularni boshqarish.

cards.ex: There's a fine line between being assertive and being aggressive.
cards.exUz: O'z fikriga ega bo'lish va tajovuzkor bo'lish o'rtasida nozik chegara bor.
cards.uzDef: Ajratish qiyin bo'lgan ikki narsa o'rtasidagi kichik farq.

cards.ex: We arrived at the airport in the nick of time; our flight was about to leave.
cards.exUz: Biz aeroportga so'nggi daqiqada yetib keldik; reysimiz uchishga tayyor edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt tugashiga oz qolganda, juda kech bo'lishidan oldin.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together if you want to pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni yig'ishtirishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tartibli va samarali bo'lishni boshlash, o'zini qo'lga olish.

cards.ex: It's just the same old thing every day: work, eat, sleep.
cards.exUz: Har kuni xuddi o'sha narsa: ish, ovqatlanish, uyqu.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarmaydigan yoki zerikarli bo'lgan narsa, avvalgidek.

cards.ex: The music set the tone for a relaxing evening.
cards.exUz: Musiqa dam olish uchun yoqimli ohangni o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yoki voqeaning umumiy hissini yoki kayfiyatini yaratish.

cards.ex: I hate running, but to each their own; some people love it.
cards.exUz: Men yugurishni yomon ko'raman, lekin har kim o'zicha; ba'zi odamlar buni yaxshi ko'radilar.
cards.uzDef: Har kim o'z didiga ko'ra tanlaydi, har kimning o'z xohishi bor.

cards.ex: I check my phone out of habit even when I know there are no new messages.
cards.exUz: Men telefonimni yangi xabarlar yo'qligini bilsam ham, odat bo'yicha tekshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Odat tufayli, odat qilinganligi sababli bajariladigan ish.

cards.ex: My nightly routine helps me relax before bed.
cards.exUz: Mening kechki odatim menga uxlashdan oldin dam olishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Har kecha uxlashdan oldin bajariladigan harakatlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: It takes a while to get into a rhythm when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish boshlaganingizda ritmga tushish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi harakatda yaxshi va barqaror bo'lish.
